svg.title: Maximum-likelihood Gaussians under three covariance restrictions
svg.desc: Four panels. First, two points in two dimensions and the full-covariance Gaussian fitted to them: its contours collapse onto the segment between the points. Then twelve correlated points fitted with a full covariance (tilted ellipses that follow the data), a diagonal covariance (axis-aligned ellipses that miss the tilt) and a spherical covariance (circles).
